Given that, we need to push the demo out. Earliest reasonable date for us is the week of Oct 18, preferably Oct 20 onward.

Also, security has asked to be present for the demo (they want to see data flows and the KV/cache behavior), and procurement asked me to delay any contract conversations by a couple of weeks while they finish a vendor comparison. I'll loop them here so they can weigh in on timing.

Sorry for the churn — would love to lock a date once you share availability.
